text:
ash: heads-up — finance pinged about a weird delta in token/unit econ for model-sku-88 after yesterday's routing policy patch. can we triage quickly?
noor: saw an alert. delta ~12% cost increase for 0-64 token requests, margin to baseline looks off.
trent: short-contexts are showing higher avg tokens per invocation in the dashboard, but latency looks fine.
mei: dashboard heatmap shows a hotspot in eu-west nodes for sku-88. curious if fallback routing sent traffic to cold skus.
garcia: I pulled the query from the econ export: 

```
SELECT sku, routing_policy, SUM(tokens) tokens, SUM(billed_cost) cost, COUNT(*) invocations
FROM econ_events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-21T00:00:00Z' AND ts < '2026-03-21T06:00:00Z'
GROUP BY sku, routing_policy;
```

garcia: results: sku-88 routing-policy-A tokens=1.2M cost=$480; routing-policy-B tokens=1.1M cost=$540. delta in cost per token between policies.
ash: ping deploy-bot: was there a routing-policy rollout that moved traffic to policy-B?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing-policy-B was enabled for sku-88 canary at 2026-03-21T01:15Z with 20% traffic ramp.
noor: that explains timing. but why higher cost? perhaps model variant selection changed or cache affinity dropped.
trent: checking per-node kv/cache stats now.
mei: quick note for console UX: we should allow side-by-side policy comparison for a selected sku and time range. simple toggle + diff column.
ash: +1. For telemetry we should add routing_policy and variant_id to the econ_events so we can attribute instantly.
garcia: we don't want to bloat prod telemetry size. prefer a derived join table that enriches econ_events asynchronously.
noor: agree. backfill join on event_id or (ts, node, request_id) so we can run historical diffs without changing emitter size.
trent: dump of kv hit rates around the window: 

```
node,sku,kv_hit
eu-west-1a,sku-88,0.86
eu-west-1b,sku-88,0.84
eu-west-1c,sku-88,0.45
```

trent: node eu-west-1c was the primary for policy-B traffic; that node's cache was smaller after the infra bump.
mei: so fallback routing -> policy-B sent to node with low cache affinity -> more regen traffic -> higher cost.
ash: action suggestions: (A) pause policy-B ramp, (B) add console diff view, (C) backfill routing tags for econ_events, (D) add per-node heatmap to cost panel, (E) alert rule for cache-affinity regressions.
garcia: I'll open PR for a derived enrichment job and a one-off backfill for last 30d. we'll keep emitter unchanged.
noor: I'm working on a light console mock: "Compare routing policies" mode that overlays two sparklines and shows % delta per metric (tokens, cache-hit, cost).
trent: ops-bot: can we pause canary ramp for routing-policy-B on sku-88?
ops-bot: ops-bot: pause executed — routing-policy-B traffic reduced to 0% for sku-88. confirmation in logs. :white_check_mark:
mei: since we paused, let's run a differential job comparing policy-A and policy-B for the last 6h to confirm regression.
ash: also add a query to surface short-seq vs long-seq split; cost impact is concentrated in <64 token bucket.
garcia: note on billing: we'll tag the backfill output with an "investigation_id" so finance can reconcile credits if needed.
noor: UX caveat: show sampling rate on the diff so viewers understand statistical confidence.
trent: add quick alert: if cost-per-invocation delta >10% between routing policies for a sku AND cache-affinity delta >12%, create a PagerDuty incident.
mei: I'll draft a small RFC for routing-policy observability + console compare mode; include proposed DB schema for enriched econ table.
ash: timeline: backfill job (garcia) ETA 24h, console mock (noor/mei) ETA 2 days, alert rule (trent) ETA today, RFC (mei) ETA EOD.
garcia: starting backfill right now, will post progress.
noor: thanks team. one more: let's add an in-console "run canary comparison" button that temporarily pins traffic splits and collects 1h of metric snapshots for a fair A/B compare. low risk and helpful for triage.
trent: agree but gate behind perms to prevent excessive canaries.
mei: logging that for the RFC.
ash: closing loop — finance will wait 24h for backfill results then we'll sync if numbers unresolved. thanks all.
